## Why visit

A worthwhile old-pub pause beside the much noisier Mathew Street circuit. Shipping pictures, a compact rear room and surviving decorative details give it local character, with Beatles associations adding another layer. Its value for this trip is the chance to drink traditional cask in an established city pub in a district often approached only for its busy nightlife. Look at the rooms and maritime references rather than expecting a museum-like preserved interior: parts of the fittings were replaced in later refurbishments.

## Beer

CAMRA lists Draught Bass as a regular cask beer with changing guests.

## Plan the visit

Football screenings can be especially busy. Use the Rainford Gardens address; there is also a White Star name at Lime Street station.

**Getting there:** By Mathew Street; Moorfields is the nearby rail option.
